cards.meaning: to shoot up, to spike (of prices, rates, numbers)
cards.example: Pumalo sa 7.2% ang implasyon noong Setyembre.
cards.exampleMeaning: Inflation shot up to 7.2% in September.
cards.note: Mula sa 'palo' (hampas); sa balita, tumutukoy sa biglaang pagtaas hanggang sa isang antas. Mas matindi kaysa 'tumaas'. Kaugnay: pumalo sa, pagpalo.

cards.example: Salat sa pera ang maraming pamilya dahil sa mataas na presyo ng pagkain.
cards.exampleMeaning: Many families are short of money because of high food prices.
cards.note: Mas mabigat ang dating kaysa 'kulang'; may kahulugang pagkakait o matagal na kakulangan. Madalas sa 'salat sa'. Kaugnay: kasalatan.

cards.meaning: as for, as to (topic-shifting connective); also 'to go so far as'
cards.example: 关税清单已经公布，至于具体税率，目前还没有消息。
cards.examplePinyin: Guānshuì qīngdān yǐjīng gōngbù, zhìyú jùtǐ shuìlǜ, mùqián hái méiyǒu xiāoxi.
cards.exampleMeaning: The tariff lists have been published; as for the specific rates, there's no word yet.
cards.note: Neutral to 书面语. Introduces a related but separate point. Contrast 关于 (about, a topic marker for the whole sentence). 至于 shifts to a sub-topic.
cards.tiesTo: US-China 30-for-30 tariff lists with no rates published

cards.meaning: to carry out, to put into effect, to follow through
cards.example: 协议能不能真正落实，还要看双方的国内程序。
cards.examplePinyin: Xiéyì néng bù néng zhēnzhèng luòshí, hái yào kàn shuāngfāng de guónèi chéngxù.
cards.exampleMeaning: Whether the agreement is truly implemented depends on each side's domestic procedures.
cards.note: 书面语/official register, very common in policy news. Collocates with 政策, 协议, 措施. Contrast 执行 (execute, mechanical) vs 落实 (make it real on the ground).
cards.tiesTo: Tariff lists still needing domestic legal steps
